item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: ‘Politics from Gambhir has damaged image of Indian team’- Ahmed Shehzad
item.description: Ahmed Shehzad, a former batter for Pakistan, attacked India coach Gautam Gambhir, accusing him of introducing politics into the Indian team's atmosphere. Gambhir is under increasing pressure after his team's crushing loss to South Africa in the T20 World Cup Super 8s stage cast doubt on their chances of making it to the semi-finals. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Needs to win convincingly,” Anil Kumble points to West Indies as benchmark for struggling India
item.description: West Indies opened their T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 campaign with a thumping 107-run victory over Zimbabwe at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai on Monday (February 23). The two-time champions rode on Shimron Hetmyer's stunning knock of 85 off 34 balls to post the second-highest total in T20 World Cup history, piling up 254/6 in 20 overs. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Rinku Singh leaves India camp; rushes back home due to medical emergency in family - Report
item.description: Middle-order batter Rinku Singh, who has featured in all of India’s T20 World Cup 2026 matches so far, has rushed back home due to a medical emergency in the family, NDTV reported. According to the report, Rinku's father is suffering from stage-4 liver cancer and is currently on ventilator support. The southpaw left the team environment to be with his family during the critical time. item.title: WATCH: Shoaib Akhtar embarrassed on live TV as Pakistan lose to England after he makes India’s T20 World Cup exit wish
item.description: Former Pakistan pacer Shoaib Akhtar was left embarrassed on live TV after his national team suffered a two-wicket defeat against England in the T20 World Cup Super 8s at Pallekele International Cricket Stadium on Tuesday (February 24).
